title: The Monday WhatsApp summary is never checked for privacy, an empty gym or the desk
what: One screen test taps Share on WhatsApp in the demo gym and checks three lines. Nothing checks that the message carries no member name or phone number, the My gym and zero lines for a new gym, that the card hides on other weekdays on screen, or that the desk never sees the card and its money totals.
expected: A screen test reads the whole message for an empty gym and a busy one, proves no member name or number is in it, and signs in as the desk to see no card.
fix_line: Extend the Monday test with an empty gym, a name check and a desk sign-in

title: What is new and its bell number are tested only as the owner, and never in the demo gym
what: Both What is new screen tests sign in as the owner. No test opens the bell or the What is new page as the front desk or a trainer, and none checks that the demo gym shows no update number. The page heading line with the version is never read.
expected: A screen test signs in as the desk, sees the update number and the page without owner-only buttons, and the demo gym shows no update number.
fix_line: Add a desk sign-in and a demo gym check to the What is new test

title: The member WhatsApp sheet never checks the number it opens, a short number, or the desk
what: Tests read the ready words in the member WhatsApp sheet, but no test presses Send and checks that WhatsApp opens on this member number. The warning for a mobile number that is not complete, the Plan ending one-by-one list, switching language and the sheet used by the front desk are never tested.
expected: A screen test sends from the sheet and checks the WhatsApp address carries this member number only, shows the short-number warning with no send button, walks the one-by-one list with a skip, and repeats as the desk.
fix_line: Add a sheet test that presses Send, tries a short number and runs as the desk

title: The paid-plan reminder on Today is never seen on screen, nor the desk Today of a trial gym
what: The line asking a paying gym to pay for the next month or year, and the line after its paid-until day, are only checked as words. No screen test shows them with their two links. No test opens Today as the front desk of a trial gym to see that no trial or payment line shows.
expected: A screen test sets a paid-until day 5 days ahead and then past, sees both lines with Pay MettleUp and See prices, and signs in as the desk to see no line.
fix_line: Add the paid-until line and a desk Today to the trial test

title: The Workout offer card on Today, the offline card and the no-receipt promise are never tested
what: No test shows the Today card that says how many rewards wait to be given, for the owner or the desk. The Workout offers need your gym online card, the Starting button and the promise that free days make no receipt and no GST are never checked.
expected: A screen test shows the Today card with 1 and then 2 rewards, taps Give, sees the card go; an offline gym shows its card; and after a reward no new receipt exists.
fix_line: Extend the offer test with the Today card, an offline gym and a receipt count

title: The desk never turns its own alerts on or off in a test, and the could-not-turn-on words are never seen
what: The alerts test signs in as the desk only to read the timing words. No test has the desk turn alerts on, off and on again on its own device, checks the owner device stays on, or shows Alerts could not be turned on when saving fails.
expected: A screen test has the desk switch its own alerts off and on, checks the owner device is untouched and only one address is kept, and shows the failure words when the save fails.
fix_line: Add a desk on-off round and a failed save to the alerts test
